public class Initialisers extends Base {
    static int counter;
    int instanceValue;

    static {
        counter = 10;
    }

    {
        instanceValue = counter + 1;
    }

    Initialisers() {
        this(1);
    }

    Initialisers(int start) {
        super(start);
        instanceValue += start;
    }
}

class Base {
    Base(int seed) {}
}
